Gathered Peoples

Many peoples share your streets. A quiet thought across a crowded room and a practiced hand with a bandage both say that someone is looking out for you.

Which old custom did your new neighbors adopt?

Rules

- Mind 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.add5fda6dfad52aa.JournalEntryPage.22d062271a2ebe36]{Silent Cue}. - Medicine 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.7f53902694b57ffd.JournalEntryPage.525847145a598d86]{Treat Soft Tissue}.

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.
